title: Arcade — Game Health
description: Engagement and reliability for the Daily Mini Games arcade.

panels.title: Sessions over time
panels.query: metric=session_start | where version = $app_version | count by day

panels.title: Sessions by game
panels.query: metric=session_start | where version = $app_version | count by game

panels.title: Errors by game
panels.query: metric=error | where version = $app_version | count by game
